`GET /invoices/<id>` in `src/api/invoices.py` now returns a 404 when the invoice doesn't exist. I haven't run it or any tests.

The 404 uses `errors.problem(404, "Invoice not found", ...)`, which gives a problem+json body as the project's error convention requires. Before this change, a missing id would have crashed with a 500 on `None.__dict__`.

I imported it as `from src.api.errors import problem`. I guessed that import path and haven't checked it against how the rest of the project imports modules.
